stories.title: Define Rate Limit Policy Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define configuration schema for rate limits including per-IP, per-session, and per-endpoint thresholds, time windows, burst limits, and override rules for internal services.
stories.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No existing rate limit config; GAP requires schema definition aligned with FastAPI config patterns

stories.title: Implement Rate Limiting Core Logic
stories.description: Build backend logic to track request counts and enforce limits using IP and session identifiers, with TTL-based rolling windows and burst handling.

stories.title: Integrate Rate Limiting via FastAPI Middleware
stories.description: Add middleware in FastAPI main entrypoint to enforce rate limits on incoming requests, inject identifiers (IP/session), and return HTTP 429 with standardized error payload.

stories.title: Rate Limiting Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating throttling behavior across IP/session scopes, burst handling, TTL reset behavior, and correct HTTP 429 responses.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py; ASSUMPTION: no current rate limit tests

stories.title: Integrate Rate Limiting with Logging and Headers
stories.description: Log rate limit violations with request metadata and expose standard rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, Remaining, Reset) for observability and client awareness.
